cards.Name: Airport
cards.Description: If you do not build anything on your turn, get 10 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Amusement Park
cards.Description: If you roll doubles, take another turn after this one.

cards.Name: Apple Orchard
cards.Description: Get 3 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Bakery
cards.Description: Get 1 coin from the bank.

cards.Name: Business Center
cards.Description: Exchange 1 of your non-landmark establishments for 1 an opponent owns.

cards.Name: Cafe
cards.Description: Take 1 coin from the active player.

cards.Name: Cheese Factory
cards.Description: Get 3 coins from the bank for each ranch establishment you own.

cards.Name: City Hall
cards.Description: After earning income, if you have no coins, get 1 coin from the bank.

cards.Name: Convenience Store
cards.Description: Get 3 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Convention Center
cards.Description: You may choose to activate another of your non-landmark establishments in place of this one. If you do, return this card to the market.

cards.Name: Corn Field
cards.Description: If you have fewer than 2 landmarks built, get 1 coin from the bank.

cards.Name: Demolition Company
cards.Description: Demolish 1 of your built landmarks (flip it back over). When you do, get 8 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Diamine
cards.Description: Get 5 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Exhibit Hall
cards.Description: You may activate 1 of your non-landmark establishments instead. If you do, return this establishment to the supply.

cards.Name: Family Restaurant
cards.Description: Take 2 coins from the active player.

cards.Name: Farmers Market
cards.Description: Get 2 coins from the bank for each wheat establishment you own.

cards.Name: Flower Garden
cards.Description: Get 1 coin from the bank.

cards.Name: Flower Shop
cards.Description: Get 1 coin from the bank for each Flower Garden you own.

cards.Name: Food Warehouse
cards.Description: Get 2 coins from the bank for each cup establishment you own.

cards.Name: Forest
cards.Description: Get 1 coin from the bank.

cards.Name: French Restaurant
cards.Description: If the active player has at least 2 landmarks built, take 5 coins from them.

cards.Name: Fruit and Vegetable Market
cards.Description: Get 2 coins from the bank for each wheat establishment you own.

cards.Name: Furniture Factory
cards.Description: Get 3 coins from the bank for each gear establishment you own.

cards.Name: General Store
cards.Description: If you have fewer than 2 landmarks built, get 2 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Hamburger Stand
cards.Description: Take 1 coin from the active player.

cards.Name: Harbor
cards.Description: When you roll the dice, if the result is 10 or greater, you may add 2 to the total.

cards.Name: International Exhibit Hall
cards.Description: You may activate 1 of your non-landmark establishments instead. If you do, return this establishment to the supply.

cards.Name: Loan Office
cards.Description: When built, get 5 coins from the bank. When activated, pay 2 coins to the bank.

cards.Name: Mackerel Boat
cards.Description: If you own a Harbor, get 3 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Member's Only Club
cards.Description: If the active player has at least 3 landmarks built, take all of their coins.

cards.Name: Mine
cards.Description: Get 5 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Moon Tower
cards.Description: You may roll 3 dice on your turn. If you do, remove 1 of the dice after rolling and only count the remaining 2.

cards.Name: Moving Company
cards.Description: Give 1 of your non-major establishments to an opponent. When you do, get 4 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Park
cards.Description: Redistribute all players' coins as evenly as possible, making up any difference with coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Pizza Joint
cards.Description: Take 1 coin from the active player.

cards.Name: Private Club
cards.Description: If the active player has at least 3 landmarks built, take all of their coins.

cards.Name: Publisher
cards.Description: Take 1 coin from each opponent for each cup and box establishment they own.

cards.Name: Radio Tower
cards.Description: Once per turn, you may reroll the dice.

cards.Name: Ranch
cards.Description: Get 1 coin from the bank.

cards.Name: Renovation Company
cards.Description: Close for renovation all copies of any 1 establishment in play. Take 1 coin from each opponent for each of their establishments closed this way.

cards.Name: Shopping Mall
cards.Description: Your cup and box establishments earn +1 coin when activated.

cards.Name: Soda Bottling Plant
cards.Description: Get 1 coin from the bank for each cup owned by all players.

cards.Name: Stadium
cards.Description: Take 2 coins from each opponent

cards.Name: Sushi Bar
cards.Description: If you own a Harbor, take 3 coins from the active player.

cards.Name: Tax Office
cards.Description: From each opponent who has 10+ coins, take half of their coins, rounded down.

cards.Name: Tech Startup
cards.Description: At the end of each of your turns, you may add 1 coin to this card. When activated, take coins from each opponent equal to the amount on this card.

cards.Name: Train Station
cards.Description: You may roll 1 or 2 dice.

cards.Name: Tuna Boat
cards.Description: The active player rolls 2 dice. If you own a Harbor, get coins from the bank equal to the result.

cards.Name: TV Station
cards.Description: Take 5 coins from an opponent.

cards.Name: Vineyard
cards.Description: Get 3 coins from the bank.

cards.Name: Wheat Field
cards.Description: Get 1 coin from the bank.

cards.Name: Winery
cards.Description: Get 6 coins from the bank for each Vineyard you own. Then close this establishment for renovation.
